messages.subject: Error when deployihg shinyapp - Quandl
parts:
I have created an app that references the Quandl package # install_github('quandl/R-package')

The app works locally, however, when I go to deploy the app, I get the following error message:

################################## Begin Log ################################## 
################################### End Log ################################### 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 144405206 failed: Error building image: Error fetching Quandl (2.7.0) source. Error accessing GitHub repository quandl/R-package. HTTP 301: Moved Permanently
Execution halted


Can anyone help me with this?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when deployihg shinyapp - Quandl
parts:
I thought we fixed this, but you can try installing using the exact name of the github repository:

install_github('quandl/quandl-r')

It looks like the repository has been renamed since you installed it.
